overall_notes: This paper is a philosophical position paper arguing that language models trained only on form cannot learn meaning. It is NOT an NLG evaluation paper. The GPT-2 examples in Appendix A are purely illustrative thought experiments to support their theoretical argument, not actual NLG experiments. The paper discusses many models (BERT, GPT-2, ELMo) and datasets (SNLI, SQuAD, DROP, etc.) but only as examples in their theoretical discussion, not as part of any evaluation study.
